source: Transcribed from the Keysight Truevolt Series Operating and Service Guide, whose SCPI Programming Reference chapter is the command reference — it is not online-help-only, as this project previously recorded. Each subsystem's Command Summary is used as the guide's own roster and the parse is checked against it: 240 of 243 matched. Keysight's inline alternation is kept as printed — MEASure[:VOLTage]:{AC|DC}? means either mnemonic stands at that node. A re-check on 10 August 2026 found all 390 entries in the guide, none unaccounted for. Worth recording, because a sweep on 7 August reported 87 of them missing and explained it as the catalog writing MEASure:{FREQuency|PERiod}? where the guide spells the two out separately. It is the other way round: the guide prints that alternation in this exact notation and prints MEASure:FREQuency? and MEASure:PERiod? nowhere. The line above had said so all along.
